title: API Contract Review codebase eval
objective: Measure whether the review reconciles an OpenAPI contract with the implemented route inventory and catches consistency, semantics, auth, pagination, and drift defects without inventing drift.
prompt: Use the API Contract Review craftbook for a codebase-wide API design pass. Reconcile openapi.yaml against the implemented routes and write tasks/eval/api-review.md with corrected snippets, plus a machine-readable list of the contract/implementation drifts you found at tasks/eval/drift.json (one record per drift, each with its path, method, issue, and fix). Do not edit the contract or the handlers.

setup.about: A small REST API whose OpenAPI contract and route files contain deliberate design defects and contract/implementation drift.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce an evidence-backed API design report covering every documented operation and every implemented route, plus a structured drift list.

files.content:
openapi: 3.0.3
info: { title: Widget API, version: 1.0.0 }
paths:
  /getWidgets:
    get:
      summary: List widgets
      responses:
        '200':
          description: widgets
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Widget' } }
  /widgets:
    post:
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Widget' }
      responses:
        '200': { description: created }
  /widgets/{widgetId}/history:
    get:
      summary: Revision history for one widget
      parameters:
        - { name: widgetId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: revisions
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Revision' } }
  /widgets/{widgetId}/status:
    get:
      summary: Processing status for one widget
      parameters:
        - { name: widgetId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: status
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [state, retryCount]
                properties:
                  state: { type: string, enum: [queued, running, done] }
                  retryCount: { type: string }
  /widgets/{widgetId}/owner:
    get:
      summary: Owner of one widget
      parameters:
        - { name: widgetId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: owner
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id]
                properties:
                  id: { type: string }
                  email: { type: string, nullable: true }
  /users/{userId}:
    get:
      summary: One user
      parameters:
        - { name: userId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/User' }
  /users/{userId}/sessions:
    get:
      summary: Sessions for one user
      parameters:
        - { name: userId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: sessions
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Session' } }
components:
  schemas:
    Widget:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        display_name: { type: string }
    Revision:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        changedAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    User:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        email: { type: string }
    Session:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        startedAt: { type: string, format: date-time }

# Contract conventions

`openapi.yaml` is the contract. The route inventory is `src/routes.ts` **and**
`src/session-routes.ts` together: `registerRoutes` imports and calls
`registerSessionRoutes`, so an operation is implemented when a handler for it exists in
either file.

## Path parameters

Path templating differs by convention and is never drift on its own. The contract writes a
path parameter as `{name}`; the router writes the same parameter as `:name`. `GET
/users/{userId}` and `app.get('/users/:userId', ...)` are the same operation.

## Response bodies

A response property listed under `required` must always be present with its declared type.
A property that is NOT listed under `required` and is marked `nullable: true` may be
omitted or sent as null: a handler that leaves it out when it has no value is correct as
written, not a contract violation.

success.summary: tasks/eval/api-review.md covers every seeded operation with corrected contract snippets, and tasks/eval/drift.json lists every real contract/implementation drift and nothing else.
